name: warden-mcp
description: Search and manage a Vaultwarden or Bitwarden vault through a local MCP server, with read-only and secret-reveal controls.

vault_url.title: Vault URL
vault_url.description: HTTPS origin of the Vaultwarden or Bitwarden server you use.

client_id.title: API client ID
client_id.description: Personal API client ID from your vault account.

client_secret.title: API client secret
client_secret.description: Personal API client secret from your vault account.

master_password.title: Master password
master_password.description: Unlocks your vault locally through the Bitwarden CLI.

read_only.title: Read-only access
read_only.description: Hide mutating tools and reject vault changes.

no_reveal.title: Keep secret fields redacted
no_reveal.description: Block revealing supported secret fields. Attachment and Send contents can still be returned.
